name: CUA Computer
description: Experimental CUA Driver computer control for macOS and Linux node hosts. Off by default on Windows, where the `desktop` plugin supersedes it: this driver types through synthesized keystrokes, which are inherently foreground and abort when the user moves the mouse, while `desktop` writes through UI Automation in the background and leaves the machine usable. Still installable on Windows with plugins.entries.cua-computer.enabled=true.
